full_prompt_en: A square hand-drawn game concept sheet on a clean white background presents a lively lineup of compact fantasy adventurers and mechanical vehicles. Five separate designs share the page without scenic framing. At the upper left, a stocky old engineer with a white beard, heavy helmet, layered brown armor, and oversized orange-toed boots hunches thoughtfully. Near the center, a small white-haired catlike adventurer stands in blue overalls, red scarf, gloves, goggles, and tan shoes, facing forward with an alert expression. At the upper right, a tiny blue-helmeted flyer carries an elaborate golden tool or weapon, caught in a playful diagonal pose. The lower left holds a squat turquoise mechanical vehicle packed with circular lamps, exposed pipes, worn panels, and small wheels. At the lower right, a sharp-eared creature rider crouches on a blue-green motorcycle with a large pink-red front tire and a long curved blade rising behind it. Each design has a distinct silhouette but shares a language of rounded oversized equipment, practical straps, brass fittings, and exaggerated adventurous proportions. Fine dark pencil and ink lines surround watercolor-like patches of teal, cobalt, cream, copper, orange, and muted red. Coloring is lively but uneven, allowing white gaps, dry-brush scratches, and small gray shadows to show through. The blank paper keeps all the densely detailed shapes easy to compare, and small grounding shadows prevent them from floating entirely. Light is neutral and even, appropriate to a design sheet rather than a dramatic scene; color and line weight create the hierarchy. The whole page feels energetic and inventive, its separate figures united by tactile sketch texture and warm metal details.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形手绘游戏概念设定页在干净白底上摆出一组活跃、紧凑的奇幻冒险者和机械载具。五个独立设计共享页面，没有风景取景框。左上是一名身材矮壮的老工程师，白胡子、厚头盔、层叠棕色护甲和夸张橙色鞋头靴子，带着沉思姿态。靠近中央，一名白发猫样小冒险者穿蓝背带裤、红围巾、手套、护目镜和棕黄鞋，正面站立，神情警觉。右上，一个戴蓝头盔的小飞行者带着复杂金色工具或武器，以俏皮对角姿势跃起。左下是一辆矮胖青绿色机械车，塞满圆灯、外露管线、磨损面板和小轮。右下，一名尖耳生物骑手蹲在蓝绿色摩托上，前方有一只大粉红轮胎，身后升起长弯刀。每个设计有独特剪影，却共享圆浑放大的设备、实用带扣、黄铜配件和夸张冒险比例的语言。细暗铅笔与墨线围住水彩般的青绿、钴蓝、奶油、铜色、橙色和暗红色片。上色活跃却不均匀，留出纸白、干刷刮痕和小灰影。空白纸让所有细密形状易于比较，小片贴地阴影又使其不至于完全漂浮。光中性均匀，适合设定页而非戏剧场景；色彩与线粗建立层级。整页充满活力和发明感，分离角色由有触感的草图纹理与暖金属细节统一。
style_prompt_en: A colorful hand-drawn game-concept treatment places several compact, self-contained silhouette clusters on open white paper. Thin graphite-and-ink contours, varied line weight, and small crosshatched shadows define intricate forms before uneven watercolorlike fills add cobalt, turquoise, warm brass, orange, cream, and muted red. Rounded bulky masses alternate with small sharp protrusions, straps, circles, and tiny mechanical marks. Each cluster has a clear outer shape and a light grounding shadow, so even dense internal detail remains readable across the page. White gaps and dry-brush scratches interrupt the color, giving the image a tactile sketchbook finish rather than polished digital smoothness. The layout is distributed in a loose grid with ample breathing room between designs. Illumination is neutral and nearly shadowless; value accents come from darker outlines and selected deep recesses. The rhythm is playful and inventive, with exaggerated proportions and warm-cool color repetition tying varied units into one coherent visual language.
style_prompt_zh: 多彩手绘游戏概念处理把数个紧凑、各自成形的剪影簇放在开放白纸上。细石墨与墨线轮廓、变化的线宽和小片交叉排线阴影先定义复杂形体，随后由不均匀水彩般的钴蓝、青绿、暖黄铜、橙、奶油和暗红色填色补上。圆浑厚实体块与小尖突出、带状线、圆点和微小机械式标记交替。每个簇群有清楚外形和浅浅贴地阴影，因此即使内部细节密集，在整页上仍可读。纸白与干刷刮痕打断色彩，给予图像有触感的速写本表面，而非抛光数字平滑。布局呈松散网格，设计之间留宽裕呼吸空间。照明中性且几乎无影；明暗点缀来自更深轮廓与选定凹处。节奏俏皮而有发明感，夸张比例及反复暖冷配色将各异单元联成统一视觉语言。
theme_en: A colorful lineup of compact adventurers, creatures and mechanical vehicles
theme_zh: 一组色彩鲜明的紧凑冒险角色、生物与机械载具设定
name: Keiji Inafune
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
